name: price
title: Price
description: What something costs, set the way a price is read.
use: A price on a plan, a product or an invoice total: large figures, a small currency mark hung from their top, a quiet period on their baseline. Put a price that no longer holds before the amount on an s element. Everything is sized from the amount.

instead.when: The figure is a measurement with a label and a change, not a cost
The amount is one cell of a table of figures

classes.name: price
classes.description: The price on one line, 36px figures in tabular numerals with a tight fit

classes.name: price-lg
classes.description: 56px figures, for the one price a page is about; the default is 36px

classes.name: price-amount
classes.description: The figures, or a word such as Free

classes.name: price-currency
classes.description: The currency mark, under half the size of the figures and level with their top

classes.name: price-period
classes.description: Per what, small and muted on the baseline: a month, a seat

classes.name: price-was
classes.description: The price that no longer holds, quiet and struck through, before the amount

properties.name: --price-size
properties.description: Size of the figures; the other parts follow it
